rundown: Bonnies beat Raiders 72-70 (OT) at State Farm Field House in Kissimmee, FL. Bonnies came back: they were down 28-21 at the half. Their win chance dropped as low as 11% along the way.
Leading the way — Raiders: Kellen Pickett 23 pts; Chadlyn Traylor 4 ast; Andrea Holden 13 reb. Bonnies: Benjamin Bill 20 pts; Taj Au-Duke 7 ast; Ryan Kalambay 9 reb.
Where Bonnies won it: they shot 46% to 41%, had 16 assists to 14 and turned it over 13 times to 16.
Against the closing line (DraftKings): Raiders closed as 1.5-point favorites and lost outright to Bonnies; the total closed at 145.5 and they combined for 142, under by 3.5.

review.title: The algo's call
review.body:
Logged before the start, last snapshot Nov 24, 9:56 AM ET. It had Raiders 50% and Bonnies 50%, projecting Raiders 75.6 – Bonnies 75.4 (151 total, Raiders by 0.1).

Final: Raiders 70 – Bonnies 72. Wrong winner: it had Raiders at 50%, and Bonnies (50%) won.

review.title: How the ratings held up
review.body:
Raiders came in with a 4% above average attack and a 2% stingier than average defense (6-0, 84.7 scored and 66.7 allowed a game over 6 games), worth about 185 and 186 games of evidence. Projected to score 75.6, they scored 70 (−5.6 points, 7% under); projected to allow 75.4, they allowed 72 (−3.4 points, 5% under).

Bonnies came in with a league-average attack and a league-average defense (5-1, 79.5 scored and 64 allowed a game over 6 games), worth about 193 and 190 games of evidence. Projected to score 75.4, they scored 72 (−3.4 points, 5% under); projected to allow 75.6, they allowed 70 (−5.6 points, 7% under).

The bigger miss was Raiders' scoring (-5.6 points against projection); both sides underscored their projections, so the game ran colder than either team's numbers said.

review.title: Where the result sat in the simulations
review.body:
Total: 142 against 151 projected (-9), about the 27th percentile of the simulated totals (a typical game swings ±14.5).

Margin: Bonnies by 2 against Raiders by 0.1 projected, about the 58th percentile of the simulated margins (typical swing ±11).

An ordinary result: inside the range the simulations expected most of the time.

review.title: Situational factors, checked
review.body: Market (Line movement signal): Bonnies ×1.02, Raiders ×1.00. It favored Bonnies, who did beat their projection by more than the other side did.

review.title: Against the market
review.body:
SBU ML (-112) at -112: the algo gave it 50% vs 50% fair (-0.1 pts) — won (+0.9u); lost to the close (closing fair chance 49%). WRST ML (-108) at -108: the algo gave it 50% vs 50% fair (+0.1 pts) — lost (-1u); lost to the close (closing fair chance 51%). SBU -1.5 (-102) at -102: the algo gave it 48% vs 48% fair (-0.2 pts) — won (+1u); lost to the closing +1.5 by 3. WRST +1.5 (-118) at -118: the algo gave it 52% vs 52% fair (+0.2 pts) — lost (-1u); beat the closing -1.5 by 3. OVER 145.5 (-112) at -112: the algo gave it 51% vs 50% fair (+0.8 pts) — lost (-1u); same number as the close. UNDER 145.5 (-108) at -108: the algo gave it 49% vs 50% fair (-0.8 pts) — won (+0.9u); same number as the close.

From the algo's snapshot to the close: spread Bonnies -1.5 → +1.5.

No bet: nothing cleared the algo's bar before the game.

review.title: Where the public and the money were
review.body:
Splits (Action Network): spread: 58% of bets on Raiders, 66% of the money — Bonnies covered; total: 83% of bets on the over, 83% of the money — it went under; moneyline: 27% of bets on Raiders, 14% of the money.

The sharp side by the algo's read was Bonnies, who won and covered.

review.title: What could have made it wrong
review.body:
Flagged going in: early-season numbers were thin.

The projection landed within its normal range anyway, so the flags didn't cost it much this time.

review.title: What the algo learns
review.body:
This game's own lesson: scoring came in at ×0.921 of the raw projection. It counts toward CBB scoring level, home edge and both teams' attack and defense corrections.

Across 1018 graded CBB games the algo now scales scoring ×0.979 and gives home teams +1.1 points. Team corrections so far: Raiders attack ×0.998, defense ×0.962 (6 games); Bonnies attack ×1.002, defense ×0.960 (6 games).

review.title: Bottom line
review.body: Wrong side, total within its normal range, margin within its normal range, no bet.
